reasoning_summary: All build gates pass and the scoring total (6.6) clears the 6.5 threshold, so build_now is technically eligible. However, the cost-to-gain ratio of 2.943 is nearly 5× the kill threshold (0.6) defined in cost_gain_model.yaml, meaning projected 4-week costs vastly exceed projected 4-week gains. Even the optimistic sensitivity scenario (1.471) is still above the kill line. With a responsiveness_signal of only 2 (no outreach test data), zero current portfolio pressure, and a one-time-purchase product with low defensibility and episodic demand, committing a build slot now is premature. A one-week defer to run a lightweight responsiveness test — posting in 2-3 founder communities and measuring click/reply rates — would either validate demand or confirm this should be killed, at near-zero cost.
